crypto.fold_definition: calendar-year folds; each fold starts with fresh starting equity and receives all pre-fold signal warmup plus five execution days of liquidity warmup
crypto.method: calendar-year independent stateful portfolio fold reruns with warmup, execution, exits, re-entry, costs, and mark-to-market portfolio accounting
